summaries.summary: A Bengaluru man committed a massacre, killing his wife, mother-in-law, and several relatives over a marital dispute.
Apple provided instructions for turning off the glowing logo on the new MacBook Pro. Additionally, other articles discussed various reviews of Apple's touchscreen models and the iPhone Duo.
Palo Alto Networks is in negotiations to acquire AI security startup Clutch for $500 million, while The New York Times is reportedly in talks to buy movie platform Letterboxd for $330 million.
India-born Nithya Raman won the Los Angeles mayoral election against a Democratic incumbent, marking a historic victory.
Trump indicated that a significant peace deal between Russia and Ukraine could be forthcoming after meeting an envoy from Putin.
Delhi is preparing for another pollution season as air quality worsens, with levels reaching 'severe' conditions.
A remake of 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time' has been released and is compared to the original, showcasing stunning graphics.
Airbnb announced plans to launch an AI travel agent in 2027 to assist travelers with trip planning and management.
Meta has introduced a feature allowing US users to video chat with their AI avatar, Muse.
OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model designed to enhance protection without compromising other companies.
Meta, Google, and TikTok are suing California's attorney general over a new law that would limit social media access for minors.
Serve Robotics is launching a new business aimed at becoming a leading provider of services for robotic technology.
A vulnerability named '*sshole' has been identified that allows hackers to exploit Linux devices via SSH.
